definitions.explanation: The number which, multiplied by itself three times, gives the number in question. A standard term in Japanese school mathematics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電卓|でんたく}→電卓：05481_dentaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{立方根|りっぽうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}した→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: I calculated the cube root on a calculator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていれば→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、{立方根|りっぽうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一辺|いっぺん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: If you know the volume, you can find the length of one side by taking the cube root.

notes:
⟦{立方|りっぽう}→立方：24083_rippou⟧ means cube (as in ⟦{立方|りっぽう}→立方：24083_rippou⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧, cubic metre) and {根|こん} here means root in the mathematical sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立方根|りっぽうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to find the cube root
- {立方根|りっぽうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take the cube root
- {立方根|りっぽうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧: to calculate the cube root

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平方根|へいほうこん}→平方根：25644_heihoukon⟧: square root — the same idea with two factors instead of three
- ⟦{立方体|りっぽうたい}→立方体：05549_rippoutai⟧: cube (the solid shape) — the geometric figure, not a number
